synthetic_smoke.python_source:
import math
import time
from runtime_pipeline import parser
records = []
for width in (25000, 25001, 100000):
    text = f"OPENQASM 2.0; qreg a[{width}]; qreg b[{width}]; cx a,b;"
    started = time.perf_counter()
    features = parser.featurize(text)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
    assert features["dependency_sample_operations"] == min(width, 25000)
    assert features["sample_interaction_edges"] == min(width, 25000)
    assert features["sample_active_qubits"] == 2 * min(width, 25000)
    assert features["n_ops"] == (width if width <= 25000 else 1)
    assert (features["dependency_sample_fraction"] == 1) == (width <= 25000)
    assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in features.values())
    assert elapsed < 15
    records.append({"broadcast_width": width, "text_characters": len(text),
                    "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "feature_count": len(features),
                    "features": {key: features[key] for key in (
                        "n_ops", "dependency_sample_operations", "dependency_sample_fraction",
                        "depth_proxy", "sample_interaction_edges", "sample_components",
                        "sample_active_qubits", "sample_degree_mean", "sample_degree_variance")}})
text = "OPENQASM 2.0; qreg q[100000]; h q[0];"
started = time.perf_counter()
features = parser.featurize(text)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
assert features["sample_degree_mean"] == features["sample_degree_variance"] == 0
assert features["sample_components"] == 100000
assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in features.values())
assert elapsed < 15
records.append({"isolated_qubits": 100000, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
                "feature_count": len(features), "sample_degree_mean": 0.0,
                "sample_degree_variance": 0.0})
